note: Privately (family) owned RV park in Sapphire Village, 10 mi south of Utica on a gravel road, at the foot of the Judith Mountains with a stream through the property. Also cabin and sheepherder-wagon rentals. Nightly, weekly and monthly rates; also advertises itself as workforce housing (short or long term). --Claude
